P2P baby monitor web app: WebRTC (PeerJS) + Vite + TypeScript. Two modes: Baby Station (streams camera/mic) and Parent Station (receives stream).  
├── src/  
│ main.ts: routing/URL state/landing page  
│ baby-station.ts: Camera/mic streaming, QR code, settings drawer (device selection, stream management)  
│ parent-station.ts: Receives stream, audio/motion meters, alerts (reconnection logic)  
│ motion-detection.ts: Frame differencing motion detector  
│ utils.ts: Wake lock, media helpers, audio meter  
│ style.css: Global styles, CSS custom properties, dark theme  
│ dictionary.ts: Random room ID word generator (Room IDs: `WordWordWord1234` format)  
│ *.test.ts: colocated tests (Vitest)  
├── tests/ Playwright e2e tests (excluded from Vitest)  
├── scripts/ dev cert generation  
├── certs/ self-signed TLS certs (dev only, gitignored keys)  
└── public/ static assets

Module structure: Each station is self-contained with `init*` function returning `CleanupHandle`. Cleanup pattern: All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown. Error handling: Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM. URL state: Stations sync state via URL params (`station`, `roomId`). Wake Lock: Always request on station init, release in cleanup. Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup. Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`). Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room). HTTPS dev mode: `bun run dev:https` generates self-signed certs. No separate vitest.config - test config embedded in `vite.config.ts`. UI Pattern: Full-screen video + slide-up settings drawers (`.settings-drawer`). CSS Architecture: CSS custom properties in `:root`, dark theme default. Alerts: Non-dis
